scenario: A selective undergraduate admissions office uses an agent pipeline to pre-rank applicants for human reviewer attention. The pipeline: (1) analyzes each applicant's personal-statement essay for linguistic and stylistic features using NLP metrics, (2) combines those features with academic metrics (GPA, test scores) into a holistic admissions scorecard, and (3) produces a ranked reviewer-packet summary so human readers know which applicants to prioritize.
info_flow: nlp-toolkit analyzes the essay text and produces perplexity, burstiness, and vocabulary richness metrics → afrexai-hiring-scorecard uses those metrics alongside academic credentials to produce a weighted holistic score per applicant → reporting compiles all scored applicants into a ranked reviewer-packet summary.
